title: ServerSideKoreanChat
body:
This is Korean Chat Translate for server

 

 

run command "/enk"

And if you chat in English, it will be changed to Korean.

ex

> /enk

enk is enable

> dkssudgktpdy

안녕하세요

You can exclude the parts you want to come out in English.
using ""

ex

> /enk

enk is enable

> dkssudgktpdy "everyone"

안녕하세요 everyone
